item.description: The DomainLookupTestCase::test_domain_lookup failure shows that ClockDomain objects aren't being compared correctly, pointing to issues in how clock domain instances are managed or compared.
item.contract: The lookup_domain method in the design object should correctly return the same ClockDomain instance for equivalent domain names, regardless of whether they come from the original module or a renamed submodule. Specifically, when looking up domain "a" in a module that has domain "a", it should return the same domain instance as when looking up "a" in a renamed submodule that was originally named "b". This is essential for proper domain resolution in hierarchical designs.
item.acceptance: DomainLookupTestCase::test_domain_lookup should pass, verifying that design.lookup_domain("a", m1) returns m1_a, design.lookup_domain("a", xm2) returns m1_b, and so forth.

item.description: Multiple simulator regression tests are failing with '_PySignalState' object has no attribute '_prev_value' errors, indicating fundamental issues in how the simulation framework tracks signal states.
item.contract: The simulator engine must properly initialize and manage _PySignalState objects for all signals during simulation setup. When signals are accessed or manipulated in simulation contexts, the _PySignalState objects must have all required attributes (including '_prev_value') properly initialized and maintained throughout the simulation lifecycle. This affects the entire simulation infrastructure and needs to be fixed at the base level.
item.acceptance: SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_tick_repeat_until, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_broken_other_trigger, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sample, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_edge, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sync_reset, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_comb_assign, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_latch, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_critical, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_struct, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_abandon_delay, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_timeout, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_abandon_changed, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_valuecastable, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_bug_588, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_bug_325, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_async_reset, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_bug_566, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_large_expr_parser_overflow, and CRCTestCase::test_crc_bytes, CRCTestCase::test_crc_words, CRCTestCase::test_crc_match, etc. should all pass.

item.description: Some tests fail with 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick' or similar errors, indicating that certain simulator objects aren't being properly initialized or are being prematurely destroyed.
item.contract: All simulator objects (processes, signals, etc.) must be properly initialized and maintained during simulation execution. When accessing methods like 'tick' on simulator objects, they must not be None. The simulator must ensure proper object lifetime management and initialization order for all components.
item.acceptance: SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_sample, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_edge, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_trigger_wrong, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_broken_multiedge, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_latch, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_timeout, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_abandon_changed, SimulatorRegressionTestCase::test_valuecastable, etc. should all pass.
